column.text: Bitcoin spot ETFs absorbed $211 million in net inflows yesterday while the broader market consolidates after a violent short-squeeze rally, leaving shorts hunted with 18.7 million dollars of liquidation versus only 7.2 million for longs. Despite this aggressive retail flush and institutional dry powder accumulating via regulated vehicles, macro data remains neutral with gold up five percent and US yields flat, suggesting no immediate regime change yet a potential reversal if whale accumulation stalls at current levels. The dominant signal is structural divergence where smart money buys the underlying asset rather than leveraging perpetual futures in bearish bets on hyperliquid tokens while positive funding persists for SOL derivatives. Fear and greed sits at 27 reflecting caution as headlines mix SpaceX partnerships with Nvidia against cyberattacks targeting Citadel Securities, yet the S&P 500 crossing 7700 to exceed a historic $70 trillion market cap provides a floor that prevents panic selling despite geopolitical noise regarding Iran sanctions removals or legislative hurdles for The CLARITY Act dropping below 16 percent probability. Traders must avoid the mid zone where risk reward ratios bleed between two and four, instead favoring mean reversion at range extremes with conservative sizing until tape clarity emerges from this mixed regime without directional tailwinds either way.
